notes: v0.3.28 - fixes the "Failed to load Python DLL" error that broke the last two updates. It was not a corrupt download: the companion app unpacks itself into a temporary folder and told the new version to reuse it, then deleted that folder as it closed - so the new build looked for its runtime somewhere that no longer existed. It is now started with a clean environment. If your companion app is currently broken, run the installer once; the part that performs an update is the version you are updating FROM, so this protects updates from here on.
